_note: Phase-0 freeze of the four held problems (protocol §3). ONLY these four IDs may appear in the known-failure registry at certification time (§3.1). Each held divergence must match its exact fingerprint; a fifth unexplained divergence BLOCKS certification. INVALID_EVIDENCE can never be converted to a hard-four exception.

held.held_scope: Full bit-identical trajectories / contact resolution across platform classes
held.must_pass_before_work: Same-platform contact/body-order invariance; cross-platform hand-verified physics microvectors (GV-PHY); ALL pre-physics inputs + contact keys exact; NO non-physics domain movement.
held.allowed_fingerprint: Exact first-divergent tick + domain + entity + field + operation + platform pair.
held.forbidden_domains: Any non-physics domain (jobs, terrain, rtsim, economy, net...). Movement there = NOT this fingerprint = blocker.

held.held_scope: Versioned prediction frames, saved history, rollback/resimulation, acknowledgements, shared kernel
held.must_pass_before_work: Input capture, tick/sequence identity, UI authority, server authority, network envelope, and IMPLEMENTED correction behavior all exact (INP/UIA/NET/REC current-envelope stable).
held.allowed_fingerprint: Exact protocol-gap record; NO server-state divergence caused by frame-rate or packet perturbation.
held.forbidden_domains: Server authoritative state. A frame-rate/packet perturbation moving server state = blocker, not this fingerprint.

held.must_pass_before_work: Short/medium-horizon market, population, social, quest, and catch-up behavior exact; long-run divergence restricted to DECLARED economy numeric fields.
held.allowed_fingerprint: Exact horizon + recurrence + fields; NO spill into non-economy domains before the recorded boundary.
held.forbidden_domains: Any non-economy domain; any economy divergence BEFORE the recorded long-horizon boundary.

held.held_scope: Byte-identical OUTPUT ARTIFACTS from independent clean rebuilds
held.must_pass_before_work: Source/dependency/asset/build manifests exact; independent builds produce IDENTICAL simulation + semantic tapes (semantic equivalence holds even if bytes differ).
held.allowed_fingerprint: Exact artifact sections/metadata that differ (BLD-H4 byte diff, classified sections).
held.forbidden_domains: The semantic corpus must remain EXACT. A semantic-tape divergence is NOT this fingerprint = blocker.

exception_law_3_1: Only H4-PHY, H4-PRD, H4-ESIM, H4-BLD may be in the known-failure registry at cert time.
Each entry names exact scenarios, seeds, platform pairs, first divergence, moved fields, forbidden domains.
A fingerprint is INVALID if it: appears earlier, appears in another scenario, moves another domain, changes classification, adds a second divergence, or disappears without an updated record.
An INVALID_EVIDENCE run can never be converted to a hard-four exception.
Any FIFTH unresolved divergence blocks certification and becomes a new engineering blocker.
